hooks.name: Enforce .venv Python for shell commands
hooks.description: Reminds the agent before every shell command execution to use .venv\Scripts\python.exe — never bare python, pytest, or pip.

action.prompt: MANDATORY: For ALL Python commands, you MUST use `.venv\Scripts\python.exe` as the interpreter. Never use bare `python`, `pytest`, `pip`, or `python3`. Examples: `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/` for tests, `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install ...` for installs, `.venv\Scripts\python.exe script.py` for scripts. Do NOT activate the venv — it does not persist across commands. This is a Windows PowerShell environment.
